entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane of the Shards, undergoing extreme change as its shards merge during the Conflux.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The convergence of Alara's shards, creating overlapping Incursion Zones.

entities.name: Incursion Zones
entities.description: Areas where Alara's shards overlap during the Conflux.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose castle intrudes on Esper's seas.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara of etherium filigree towers.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The dead shard of necropolises, bursting through Jund's lava.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A volcanic shard of Alara with red-hot pools of lava.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose red mana seeps into Bant.

entities.name: Reliquary Tower
entities.description: A lost Bant landmark that emerged on one of the seas of Esper.

entities.name: Galanda Feudkiller
entities.description: An arbiter giant whose amphitheater is represented by Ancient Amphitheater.

entities.name: Ancient Amphitheater
entities.description: The amphitheater of the arbiter giant Galanda Feudkiller.

entities.name: Paragon of the Amesha
entities.description: A Bant advance scout who uses foreign mana seeping into Bant.

events.summary: The convergence of the shards lets creatures travel into neighboring shards.
events.quote: We got to show how the convergence of the shards has allowed creatures from each shard had traveled into shards that border their own.

events.summary: A Bant castle emerges through the terrain, intruding on a sea of Esper.
events.quote: which shows Bant intruding on one of the seas of Esper

events.summary: Grixis terrain bursts through Jund lava while Jund crags pierce Grixis necropolises.
events.quote: The dead terrain of Grixis would burst up through Jund's red-hot pools of lava, while the volcanic crags would pierce through Grixis's necropolises.

events.summary: Bant barely touches black and red mana at the Conflux, yet Paragon of the Amesha uses it.
events.quote: At the time of the Conflux, Bant has barely come in contact with black mana (from Esper) and red mana (from Naya)

relations.note: Bant intrudes on Esper's seas at the overlap
relations.quote: which shows Bant intruding on one of the seas of Esper

relations.note: The amphitheater belongs to the giant
relations.quote: Ancient Amphitheater is the amphitheater of the arbiter giant, Galanda Feudkiller.
